title: Indexability
content: Indexability is whether a page is eligible to be stored in a search engine’s index, given its access, content, and indexing directives.

meta.why: Being reachable is one part of appearing in search, since a reachable page can still request exclusion.
meta.example: A guide loads successfully but includes a noindex directive left over from a staging environment.
meta.check: Use URL Inspection, check the robots meta tag and the X-Robots-Tag response header, and confirm that the intended canonical is eligible.
meta.limitation: Eligibility does not guarantee indexing, and Google’s AI supporting links also require the page to be eligible for snippets.
